scope.description: Players competing to automate medication dispensing and adherence for home care and supported living, plus adjacent pharmacy-automation and software-only adherence substitutes.
inclusion_logic: in-home automated dispensing services (pouch/sachet or loose-pill) sold to care organizations, municipalities, or caregivers
adjacent upstream pharmacy multi-dose packaging automation that produces the sachets in-home robots dispense
indirect software-only adherence apps and smart pillboxes that compete on price rather than the assisted-care value proposition
notes: Every business stat carries an official source and reported scope.
Third-party-aggregator figures (e.g. estimated revenue or total funding on Crunchbase/PitchBook-type profiles) are deliberately omitted to avoid unverified precision.
Market-size estimates vary widely by definition and are not attributed to any single player here.

players.name: Evondos Group
players.description: The reference company: a locked in-home robot that dispenses pharmacy-prepared multi-dose sachets on schedule, reminds the patient, locks away and escalates missed doses, and is monitored remotely by care staff — sold as a full managed service to municipalities and home-care organizations. Market leader in the Nordics; acquired Dutch leader Medido in 2023 and Vitacam vitals-monitoring in 2024, and entered the UK in 2025. Majority-owned by Verdane.

business_stats.scope: Evondos Oy standalone (Finnish company registry); group revenue including Medido is higher
Evondos Group across the Nordics and Netherlands (company-reported)
growth financing from BlackRock Private Credit

Evondos appoints Frans Cromme as CEO

players.name: Medido (Evondos Group)
players.description: The #1 in-home automated sachet dispenser in the Netherlands: a wall/counter device that cuts and dispenses roll-packed multi-dose sachets on schedule with remote monitoring. Acquired by Evondos in February 2023, forming Evondos Group. Now a product line rather than an independent competitor, but a distinct market presence in the Netherlands.

business_stats.scope: adherence before vs after automated home dispensing (Medido / AHMD)

players.name: iZafe Group (Dosell)
players.description: Evondos's closest listed Nordic competitor. Dosell dispenses dose-packed sachets on schedule, reminds patients, and alerts care staff on missed doses, sold to municipalities and home care and increasingly direct-to-consumer. iZafe also owns Pilloxa (a smart pillbox and adherence-software platform). Listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.

business_stats.scope: iZafe Group year-end report Oct–Dec 2023 (small early-stage base)

business_stats.source_title: 450 of the latest Dosell produced and delivered to partners

players.name: Spencer Health Solutions
players.description: An in-home connected medication hub ("spencer") shipped with pre-packaged medications that dispenses on schedule, captures biometrics, and runs telehealth and ePRO questionnaires, with pharmacist monitoring. Rooted in Parata Systems (pharmacy dispensing robots); strong pivot toward clinical-trial and pharma programs.

business_stats.source_title: RTP-based Spencer Health Solutions raises $43 million

business_stats.scope: daily adherence across the spencer program (company-reported)

players.name: Hero Health
players.description: A consumer/caregiver-focused countertop smart pill dispenser that sorts and dispenses loose pills (not sachets), gives reminders, automates refills, and provides caregivers real-time adherence data, sold on a subscription model.

players.name: MedMinder
players.description: A cellular-connected automatic pill dispenser combined with an integrated mail-order pharmacy: a locking dispenser pre-filled with pharmacy-sorted medications that lights and alerts on schedule, notifies caregivers on missed doses, and auto-refills, aimed at seniors aging in place.

players.name: Dignio (AceAge / Karie)
players.description: Karie is a one-button in-home automated pill dispenser (pharmacy-loaded, caregiver-connected) developed by AceAge, now operating under Norwegian remote-care company Dignio — giving a loose-pill dispenser a European remote-care footprint that overlaps Evondos's markets.

players.name: Pilloxa (iZafe Group)
players.description: A connected smart pillbox plus white-label medication-adherence software platform — lower-touch than a full dispensing robot. Pharma-partnered (Bayer, Sandoz Nordics) and used in clinical trials. Owned by iZafe Group; competes on price and lightweight adherence rather than the assisted-care robot value.

players.name: Medisafe
players.description: A software-only medication-adherence app and pharma patient-engagement platform. No hardware or dispensing; competes as a low-cost substitute for adherence reminders rather than assisted dispensing, but relevant as the software floor of the adherence market.

business_stats.scope: Series C led by Sanofi Ventures and Alive Israel

players.name: Omnicell
players.description: A pharmacy and medication-management automation vendor (dispensing cabinets, and multi-dose pouch/blister automation via JVM) that sits upstream: it helps produce the multi-dose packaging that in-home dispensing robots consume, rather than competing for the in-home care contract directly.
